questions.question: For real numbers $a \lt b$, what are $a$ and $b$ called for intervals such as $[a,b]$ or $(a,b)$?
questions.explanation: For intervals like [a,b] or (a,b), the values a and b are called endpoints.
questions.source_support: Definition: $a$ and $b$ are called endpoints of $(a,b)$, $[a,b]$, $(a,b]$, or $[a,b)$.
